Q: How to reshape from long to wide format filling NAs with zeros A:

1) Sticking with the framework in the question replace each NA in the input with NaN. Then we can distinguish the type of missing value as NaN (missing value coming from input) or NA (missing value resulting from reshape):

res <- reshape(
  replace(df, is.na(df), NaN),
  idvar = "ID",
  timevar = "region",
  direction = "wide"
)
res

##   ID status.A status.B
## 1  1        1      NaN
## 3  2        1        1
## 5  3      NaN       NA

If it is important that the original NA's be NA and the ones from reshape are 0 then add this:

res[is.na(res) & !is.nan(as.matrix(res))] <- 0
res[is.na(res)] <- NA

2) In the question's example we only have 1 and NA in the status column so if those are the only possibilities we could represent status using a logical variable instead in which case the entire problem goes away:

reshape(
  transform(df, status = !is.na(status)),
  idvar = "ID",
  timevar = "region",
  direction = "wide"
)

##   ID status.A status.B
## 1  1     TRUE    FALSE
## 3  2     TRUE     TRUE
## 5  3    FALSE       NA

3) We could use tapply from base R as it has a default argument. It returns a matrix ta so if that is ok we are done. If a data frame is needed then use the second line as well.

ta <- tapply(df[[3]], df[-3], c, default = 0)
data.frame(ID = rownames(ta), ta, row.names = NULL)

##   ID  A  B
## 1  1  1 NA
## 2  2  1  1
## 3  3 NA  0

Q: OS X v10.8.2 (Mountain Lion) Python 3 import SQLite error A:

Homebrew provides python3 with sqlite3 support and loadable modules.

brew install python3 will do the right thing (and brew sqlite, too).

There was a bug, that probably struck you, but it has been fixed

Q: How do you open multiple markdown previews at the same time in VS Code? A:

  1. install vscode extension for .md files - Markdown Preview Enhanced (by yiyi wang)

  2. go to settings (ctrl + ,), search for "markdown-preview-enhanced:preview mode" -> set it to multiple preview mode

  3. done

Note: only works when 'Markdown Preview Enhanced (by yiyi wang)' is installed

I haven't used any other extension yet.
